parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - Options to configure the hook, by default it will lock the scroll automatically.

properties.name: autoLock
properties.description: Whether to lock the scroll initially.

properties.name: lockTarget
properties.description: The target element to lock the scroll (default is the body element).

properties.name: widthReflow
properties.description: Whether to prevent width reflow when locking the scroll.

returnType.name: UseScrollLockReturn
returnType.description: - An object containing the lock and unlock functions.
